blocks.text: The Knowledge of Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA)

Hadhrat Masrooq reports that Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) once said, "If Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) were our age, none of us would be able to equal even a tenth of his knowledge." Another narration adds that Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) said, "Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) is an excellent commentator of the Qur'aan." [^1]
Hadhrat Mujaahid reports that Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) used to be called an ocean because of the great amount of knowledge he possessed. [^2]

Hadhrat Layth bin Abu Sulaym says that he once said to Hadhrat Tawoos, "Why have you attached yourself to this youngster (Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA)) instead of the senior Sahabah (RA) of Rasulullaah ﷺ?" Hadhrat Tawoos replied, "I have seen seventy Sahabah (RA) who favoured the opinion of Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) whenever a difference of opinion arose in any matter." [^3]

Hadhrat Aamir the son of Hadhrat Sa'd bin Abi Waqqaas (RA) reports that his father said, "I have never seen as quick-witted, as intelligent, as knowledgeable and as tolerant as Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA). I saw that when an intricate problem arose, Umar bin Khattaab (RA) would call for him and say, 'Be prepared! A most complicated problem is coming your way.' Umar (RA) would then accept his opinion on the matter even though he would be surrounded by veterans of the Battle of Badr both from the Muhaajireen and the Ansaar." [^4]

Hadhrat Abu Zinaad narrates that Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) was suffering from high fever when Hadhrat Umar bin Khattaab (RA) came to visit him. Hadhrat Umar (RA) said, "Your illness has certainly posed a great obstacle to us. Nevertheless it is only from Allaah that we seek help." [^5]

Hadhrat Talha bin Ubaydullaah (RA) said, "Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) has been blessed with deep understanding, intelligence and tremendous knowledge. I have not seen Umar bin Khattaab (RA) give precedence to any other person's opinion over his." [^6]

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Muhammad bin Ubay bin Ka'b
blocks.text: Hadhrat Muhammad the son of Hadhrat Ubay bin Ka'b (RA) says that Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) was once present when Hadhrat Ubay bin Ka'b (RA) stood up and said, "This youth will soon become the most learned scholar of this Ummah. Together with being blessed with intelligence and deep understanding, Rasulullaah ﷺ also prayed to Allaah to grant him a sound understanding of Deen." [^7]
